name: FA_WORK_ORDER_HEADERS
description: FA_WORK_ORDER_HEADERS contains work orders that you want to add to assets. When adding a work order for an asset, Oracle Fusion Assets inserts a row into this table. One or more work orders can be entered for an asset. Each row in the table represents a work order and can have multiple work order lines in its child table, FA_WORK_ORDER_LINES.

columns.name: ORDER_HEADER_ID
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Identifier of the work order.

columns.name: ORDER_NUMBER
columns.description: Unique identifier of the work order number.

columns.name: ORDER_STATUS_CODE
columns.description: Status of the work order. Possible values are ENTERED and COMPLETED.

columns.name: ASSET_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the asset number.

columns.name: BOOK_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Unique book identification name.

columns.name: DOCUMENT_NAME
columns.description: Name of the document for the work order.

columns.name: DOCUMENT_NUMBER
columns.description: Number of the document for the work order.

columns.name: DOCUMENT_DATE
columns.description: Date the document for the work order was created.

columns.name: WORK_ORDER_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Code for the type of the work order. Possible values are REPAIR, RECONSTRUCTION, and MODERNIZATION.

columns.name: NBV_BEFORE_MAINTENANCE
columns.description: Net book value before the work order.

columns.name: ACTUAL_USAGE_LIFE
columns.description: The life of the asset on the date of the work order.

columns.name: CONTRACTOR_ID
columns.description: Contractor identification number.

columns.name: CONTRACTOR_OKPO_CODE
columns.description: Special OKPO code of the external organization that performed the repairs or modernization. This OKPO code is manually entered by users.

columns.name: TRANSFER_FLAG
columns.description: Identifies whether the work order is transferred.

columns.name: AMORTIZE_FLAG
columns.description: Determines whether to amortize the net book value (NBV) over the remaining useful life.

columns.name: AMORTIZATION_START_DATE
columns.description: Date to start amortizing the net book value for an asset if the transaction is amortized.

columns.name: COST_ADJUSTMENT_AMOUNT
columns.description: Amount used to adjust the asset.

columns.name: CONTRACT_NUMBER
columns.description: Unique identifier of the contract number.

columns.name: CONTRACT_DATE
columns.description: Date on which the contract was created.

columns.name: CONTRACT_REPAIR_DATE_FROM
columns.description: Repair start date according to the contract.

columns.name: CONTRACT_REPAIR_DATE_TO
columns.description: Repair end date according to the contract.

columns.name: ACTUAL_REPAIR_DATE_FROM
columns.description: Actual date that repairs begin.

columns.name: ACTUAL_REPAIR_DATE_TO
columns.description: Actual date that repairs are completed.

columns.name: COMMITTEE_CHAIRPERSON_JOB_ID
columns.description: Authorizing committee chairman job identification number.

columns.name: COMMITTEE_CHAIRPERSON_ID
columns.description: Authorizing committee chairman identification number.

columns.description: Authorizing first committee member job identification number.

columns.description: Authorizing second committee member job identification number.

columns.description: Authorizing second committee member identification number.

columns.name: DELIVERED_BY_PERSON_JOB_ID
columns.description: Employee job identification number of the person who delivered the work order.

columns.name: DELIVERED_BY_PERSON_ID
columns.description: Employee identification number of the person who delivered the work order.

columns.name: DELIVERED_BY_PERSON_DATE
columns.description: Date the work order was delivered.

columns.name: ACCEPTED_BY_PERSON_JOB_ID
columns.description: Employee job identification number of the person who accepted the work order.

columns.name: ACCEPTED_BY_PERSON_ID
columns.description: Employee identification number of the person who accepted the work order.

columns.name: ACCEPTED_BY_PERSON_DATE
columns.description: Date the work order was accepted.

columns.name: CHANGES_TO_ASSET
columns.description: Details of the maintenance work that was done.

columns.name: COMMENTS
columns.description: Asset reviewer comments for the work order.

columns.name: LOAD_REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Oracle Fusion Enterprise Resource Planning: process ID of the loader job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
